answer_1.quote: The task of Difficulty-Controllable Question Generation (DCQG) aims at generating questions with required difficulty levels ...

answer_2.quote: The automatic evaluation metrics are BLEU3, BLEU4, METEOR, which measure the similarity between the generation results and the reference questions ...

answer_4.quote: The generated questions are manually evaluated by eight human annotators, who are graduate students, majoring in English Literature, Computer Science, or Electronic Engineering.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators evaluate the generated questions on multiple dimensions.
